title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode5 Deepest Despair

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despair...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How do I imagine the prince's despair? How do I express it? That will be key to this show.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And to answer that, I'll need to do as Asahi suggested, and grasp what would drive me to my own deepest despair.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just can't picture it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've come close to despair many times.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I couldn't do anything for Saki, suffering from her illness. When my first show ended in failure. When I was made to realize my own inadequacy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How powerless I felt...each time. But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I never despaired so much that I could not get back on my feet. Even powerless, I could still stand again.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In this scene, Prince Blesse has fallen completely into despair. He can't even bring himself to move.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A situation in which I would despair that completely...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's no use...
I'm only spinning my wheels...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's late, but... Perhaps I should go to SEKAI and clear my head.
se_event_forlight_2025_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is that a voice...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The others should all be in bed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
C-Could it be...?!
Tenma Household - Living Room
se_event_forlight_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If this is a robber, I must drive them off...! Or no, should I call the police first?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Either way, I, Tsukasa Tenma, will protect my fami—
Hm?

rows.Speaker: TV Commercial
rows.Line:
“Choose insurance that lets you bloom!
Flower Life Insurance.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... I see. It's only the TV.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Someone must have forgotten to turn it off. Honestly... Where's the remote...?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “And now, world news.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “The conflict ignited by last week's military invasion has had a severe impact on the region.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “Tensions continue to rise between the two countries, which experts in the UN warn could escalate into a cycle of...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: War...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That is something I can scarcely imagine.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Bombs falling on the land you were born and raised on.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Buildings, schools...destroyed. Faces darkened by grief and rage.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Everyday life ends just like that, and smiles and laughter vanish...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not something I want to imagine too vividly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Someday, I want to be able to bring smiles and relief even to people suffering like that.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (To do that, I need to refine my skills and become better at grasping my roles, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The road ahead of me is still so long...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What would drive me to deepest despair...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've asked myself this many times now, and I believe I've started to grasp the answer.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I were to fully despair, it would be because...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, but that would be...
Hop, hop, hop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I hear something again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hop hop!!!
Hoppy evening, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Waugh! M-Miku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's with all the hopping?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe. I was thinking about a show about bunnies, and I started hopping around before I even knew it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-Is that so?
Free-spirited as always, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehehe, not really♪
Are you here to practice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I still need to deepen my understanding of the prince.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ooh☆
That's the prince for your show for the contest, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's gonna be so much fun! You're really really good at playing princes☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well... This one isn't going so smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's not?!
Why not, why not?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
To put it simply...
My imagination isn't strong enough.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been thinking about the prince and his despair all day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see... So you've been thinking about how to sink into despair!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I do...have an answer, of a sort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? You do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. If I were to fully despair...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It would be because I had lost my dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean your dream of being a star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. To be precise, it would be because I had given up on it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
To give up on my greatest dream...
I'm sure it would sink me deep into despair.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Losing sight of what to do next, losing my goal in life... I might even lose sight of who I am.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So if I want to grasp the true shape of despair, I need only picture the moment I give up on my dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... There's a problem with that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A problem?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I simply can't picture myself ever giving up on my dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've decided you'll become a star, absolutely definitely, no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even if an accident claimed both my legs, or if I lost the ability to speak... I would never give up on my dream of becoming a star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I resolved to chase my dream, no matter what befalls me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
You never change, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I take pride in the strength of my own resolve.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's made understanding the prince's despair difficult. I'm not certain how to proceed from here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
I'll never catch up to Asahi like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Asahi? Oh... Right, you said you were practicing with him!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I've already learned quite a bit from him and his castmates.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... At the same time, I can see clearly how much faster he is than me, and how much further down the path he is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... But, well. There's nothing for it but to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to push forward and blaze a path for myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Somehow, Tsukasa's gaze is so distant today.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It must really, really frustrate him that Asahi is so far ahead of him.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But he's swallowing down all those frustrated and sad feelings and moving forward little by little...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really are so cool.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you beat me at rock paper scissors, I'll tell you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm? Well, that just makes me even more curi—
Tsukasaaa!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oop? That voice...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you're here too, Miku! Good wonderhoy evening!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought we might find you here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all... What are you doing here?!
